newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Heart attack kills woman in Philippine earthquake.
newsitem.headline: Heart attack kills woman in Philippine earthquake.

text.p: A woman died of a heart attack while fleeing her house during an earthquake that struck the central Philippines on Wednesday, local officials said on Thursday.
The 6.2 magnitude tremor caused cracks in several buildings and houses in Dolores and Borongan towns on nearby Samar island, town mayor Emiliana Villacarilla told reporters.
The woman, who was in her 60s, was rushing out of her house in Dolores when she suffered the heart attack, the mayor said.

The tremor originating in the sea 42 km (26 miles) northeast of Borongan, was the fourth earthquake in the Philippines in less than two weeks. Earthquakes often hit the country but only a few are big enough to cause major damage.
